lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for single-test change kinds (adoption layout, choose_path layout, finish copy, home layout, sign_in incentive, sign_in layout, sign_in redesign).
Redesigning adoption screens (adoption, redesign) and adding hints to the sign-in screen (sign_in, hint) were helpful and produced winning tests.
Copy revisions on path selection (choose_path, copy) and adding new screens at the finish step (finish, new_screen) consistently hurt performance.
No clear effect was seen for waiting screen changes (home hint, notification, redesign, wait_info) or finish step tweaks (finish hint, redesign).
Predictions were generally too high compared to noise-corrected measured outcomes.

candidates.title: Two-column layout redesign for adoption certificate screen
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a two-column layout separating certificate details from pet preview visual.
candidates.why: Adoption screen redesigns have proven to improve completion rates, and adoption is a key drop-off step with median 89s completion.

adoption_certificate.headline: Adopt Your New Desktop Companion
adoption_certificate.body: Your pet certificate is officially ready. Welcome your new companion to your desktop!

guard.reason: Valid layout redesign of the adoption certificate screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Adoption redesigns consistently perform well (+2.3% over 10 tests).

candidates.title: Interactive pet naming flow on adoption certificate screen
candidates.change: Introduce an interactive pet name entry input component on the adoption certificate screen before completing adoption.
candidates.why: Enhancing adoption interactivity deepens user connection and addresses support reports of pet resets and missing pets.

guard.reason: Valid component addition to the adoption certificate screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Addresses support complaints but adding interactive steps carries conversion risk.

candidates.title: Reorder sign-in screen after adoption certificate screen
candidates.change: Move the sign-in step to occur immediately after adoption certificate completion rather than before friend selection.
candidates.why: Completing adoption first creates momentum before asking for sign-in, helping improve the overall 30.5% finish rate.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in step after adoption certificate is explicitly allowed by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign-in showed +0.0% average lift across 3 tests.

candidates.title: List layout redesign for sign-in screen
candidates.change: Rebuild the sign-in screen into a structured list layout clearly detailing authentication options.
candidates.why: Sign-in drop-off (82.4% conversion, mean 567s) and 10 support tickets regarding sign-in stalling show layout improvements are needed.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Save Your Pet
sign_in.body: Use your primary account to keep your pet synchronized across desktop sessions.

guard.reason: Valid layout redesign of the sign-in screen.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from support mail, but sign-in redesigns previously hurt conversion (-7.6%).

candidates.title: Previous account email match hint on sign-in screen
candidates.change: Add a prominent hint advising users to log in with their existing account email to prevent losing previous pets.
candidates.why: Sign-in hints previously succeeded in tests, directly targeting 8 support emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Sign in with the same account email previously used to restore existing desktop pets.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.hint' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Custom pet photo lighting tip on photo upload screen
candidates.change: Add a clear tip on the photo upload screen recommending bright front-facing lighting for custom pet photos.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failing or rendering incorrectly during adoption photo upload.

upload_photos.hint: Ensure bright, clear lighting and a single face focus when uploading custom pet photos.

guard.reason: Valid lighting hint added to the custom photo upload screen.

candidates.score_note: Low cost hint addressing specific support issues; hints historically yield positive results.

candidates.title: List layout redesign for home intro screen
candidates.change: Rebuild the home intro screen using a list layout to present pet desktop placement status.
candidates.why: Finish step drop-off is highest (64.8% completion, 30.5% overall finish), and users reported confusion about controlling their pet.

home_intro.headline: Your Desktop Companion is Ready
home_intro.body: Your pet will now appear directly on your desktop wallpaper area.

guard.reason: Valid layout redesign of the home intro overlay screen.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has highest drop-off, but layout changes at finish step historically reduced conversion (-4.1%).

candidates.change: Add a cloud save status badge to the sign-in screen emphasizing pet preservation.
candidates.why: Addresses top user concern (8 emails about lost pet data) while motivating completion at sign-in.

components.text: Cloud Save Active: Preserves pet data and progress across logins

candidates.score_note: Addresses top data loss complaints at low cost, sign_in incentive showed positive initial result (+2.5%).

candidates.why: The waiting step has a long mean duration of 2336s, causing user uncertainty about app loading progress.

candidates.change: Add an audio ready alert toggle on the waiting screen so users get notified when desktop initialization finishes.
candidates.why: High mean waiting duration (2336s) leads users to leave the app unattended while waiting for desktop pet launch.

Redesigning adoption screens (adoption, redesign) and adding hints to sign-in (sign_in, hint) were helpful and produced multiple winning tests.
Copy revisions on path selection (choose_path, copy) and adding new screens at the finish step (finish, new_screen) consistently hurt performance.
